param_list.description: The text to be checked. This or 'data' is required.

A language code like `en-US`, `de-DE`, `fr`, or `auto` to guess the language automatically (see `preferredVariants` below). For languages with variants (English, German, Portuguese) spell checking will only be activated when you specify the variant, e.g. `en-GB` instead of just `en`.

EXPERIMENTAL: Comma-separated list of language codes to check if a word is not similar to one of the main language (parameter `language`). Unknown words that are similar to a word from the main language will still be considered errors but with type `Hint`. For languages with variants (English, German, Portuguese) you need to specify the variant, e.g. `en-GB` instead of just `en`.
A language code of the user's native language, enabling false friends checks for some language pairs.

Comma-separated list of preferred language variants. The language detector used with `language=auto` can detect e.g. English, but it cannot decide whether British English or American English is used. Thus this parameter can be used to specify the preferred variants like `en-GB` and `de-AT`. Only available with `language=auto`.
IDs of rules to be enabled, comma-separated
IDs of rules to be disabled, comma-separated
IDs of categories to be enabled, comma-separated
IDs of categories to be disabled, comma-separated
If true, only the rules and categories whose IDs are specified with `enabledRules` or `enabledCategories` are enabled.

disabledRules.description: IDs of rules to be disabled, comma-separated

200.description: the result of checking the text

dependencies: If the parameter preferredVariants is provided, the parameter language must be equal to auto;
If the parameter enabledOnly is true and neither enabledRules nor enabledCategories is provided, then no rules or categories will be enabled;
The same rule ID should not appear in both enabledRules and disabledRules simultaneously to avoid conflicts;
The same category ID should not appear in both enabledCategories and disabledCategories simultaneously to avoid conflicts;
If the parameter altLanguages is provided, the parameter language must also be provided;
